panels.title: Degraded Dependencies
panels.description: Dependencies that wallet-serving readers keep serving without, such as the node behind broadcast. Readers answer 200 through these, so they do not appear under Traffic-Blocking Services.

panels.title: Served Chain Age
panels.description: Seconds since the canonical writer committed the chain epoch each reader serves. It grows while the node or ingest stops advancing the served chain, even though the reader stays ready.
